decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-9f87423e7dd1] says more than the changelog line [ev-9365c607d0c4]: it fixes an error raised when setting the labels on the ServerUp gauge metric. That is the change: before, an error was raised; after, it is not. The only changed file is pkg/healthcheck/healthcheck.go [ev-16ec7712150b], which places the ServerUp metric in the health-check code. That suggests only setups with metrics enabled and health checks configured are exposed, but this is inferred from the file path, not stated. The evidence does not say what the error caused, so the consequence can only be written as an informational bug fix that needs no operator action, hence the low confidence.
